description: This file defines an authentication context for a React application, utilizing React's context API and hooks to manage user login state, registration, and logout functionalities. It simulates backend behavior using localStorage for demo purposes.

methods.name: useAuth()
methods.description: Custom hook to access authentication context values.

methods.name: AuthProvider({ children })
methods.description: React component that provides authentication state and methods to its children.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Simulates user login by storing user data in localStorage.

methods.name: logout
methods.description: Logs out the user by removing data from localStorage.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Registers a new user; in this demo, it calls login without backend validation.
